items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: Yes. My mother used to listen to him.

ctx.x: Columbia. It’s a beautiful — it’s just all view of water and mountains, and hang out with my cousin and learning how to skip rocks. So I was trying to get the idea of rock skipping, getting past three, getting past four, getting past five, and the whole calm kind of feeling of the water lapping on the beach. So I — you know I had a lot to work with there. So it’s called “Rock Skipping Under the Half Moon” because we were always out there just before dinner or just after dinner, and then we were being called in…
I love it. Are you familiar with the American Entertainer Steve Allen?
Yes. My mother used to listen to him.
